Promptr Studio Pro 6.1

New

  • GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst and Flare. OpenAI's new image models: Sunburst for precise edits, Flare for fast everyday images. A new detail control sets how finely the image is worked out, at no extra cost.
  • Topaz Wonder 4. The newest generative image upscaler from Topaz.

Improvements

  • Paul builds larger 3D sets in stages and sees photos you attach right away.
  • Connecting your phone as a camera is more reliable, also over the cable.
  • The feedback link now opens our Discord community directly.

Promptr Studio Pro 6.0.1

Fixes

  • Minor bug fixes.

New in 6.0 (if you are updating from an earlier version)

  • Agent, Studio and Nodes. Switch how you work from the bar at the bottom of the window (⌘1, ⌘2, ⌘3). Studio works as before.
  • Agent mode. Work with Paul in a full-window chat. With Work through he finishes multi-step jobs on his own, suggests the right resolution for each video and shows what the chat has cost.
  • Cut. Paul arranges clips, music and sound on a timeline and exports the finished film to your gallery.
  • Nodes mode. Build workflows from model and tool nodes, see the cost of every step before you run it, and run several nodes at once.
  • Media pool. Open a folder to slide its media out next to the chat or the canvas and drag it straight in.
  • A new title bar with tabs, a choice of accent colours and a name for your agent.
  • Clearer messages when a usage limit is reached, and easier-to-read secondary text.
  • Sign-in now asks you to accept the terms of service and the data processing agreement.

Promptr Studio Pro 6.0

Three ways to work

  • Agent, Studio and Nodes. Switch how you work from the bar at the bottom of the window (⌘1, ⌘2, ⌘3). Studio works as before.
  • Agent mode. Work with Paul in a full-window chat. With Work through he finishes multi-step jobs on his own, suggests the right resolution for each video and shows what the chat has cost.
  • Cut. Paul arranges clips, music and sound on a timeline and exports the finished film to your gallery.
  • Nodes mode. Build workflows from model and tool nodes, see the cost of every step before you run it, and run several nodes at once.
  • Media pool. Open a folder to slide its media out next to the chat or the canvas and drag it straight in.

Also new

  • A new title bar with tabs, a choice of accent colours and a name for your agent.
  • Clearer messages when a usage limit is reached, and easier-to-read secondary text.
  • Sign-in now asks you to accept the terms of service and the data processing agreement.
